description: Wait 0.5-10 seconds (until/gone: up to that, returning once the text appears or goes), then return what changed. Only for a page still loading or saying it is working: actions already wait for the requests they start.

gone.description: Return once this text is gone

in.description: Only within this element; the reply says whether it already held when the wait began

snapshot.description: Default true; false: evidence and notes only, as in browser_click.

until.description: Return once the page shows this text

name: browser_wait
title: Wait
